item.title: Alabama baseball heads to Frisco Classic
item.description: Alabama baseball will play its first game of three in the 2026 Frisco College Baseball Classic Tournament on Friday. item.description: The emergence of sophomore forward Aiden Sherrell has been the driving force of Alabama’s seven-game winning streak.
